tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Laboratory findings indicate a positive result for Influenza B virus RNA, with all other tested respiratory viruses negative. This suggests an active Influenza B infection as the likely cause of current respiratory symptoms. No evidence of co-infection with other common respiratory viruses was detected.
